title: Correction to: Efficacy and safety assessment of probiotic Bacillus coagulans (Heyndrickxia coagulans) BCP92 for treatment of diarrhea
content: This is a correction to: Sohel S Shaikh, Snehal Patel, Anis Malik, Aakash Kumar S, Efficacy and safety assessment of probiotic Bacillus coagulans (Heyndrickxia coagulans) BCP92 for treatment of diarrhea, Toxicology Research, Volume 13, Issue 6, December 2024, https://doi.org/10.1093/toxres/tfae182
